questions.text: What is the primary entry point component and orchestration service responsible for handling user registration requests and role-specific data?
What are the ordered sequence of calls between the API controller, validation service, domain logic, and persistence components during a user registration attempt?
How do components interact to verify the uniqueness and validity of account data, and what observable failure paths or error responses are returned when duplicate or invalid data is provided?
How is the database interaction structured when persisting newly created user accounts and their associated role-specific attributes (such as student IDs or librarian identifiers)?
What are the interface contracts and dependencies between the validation components and the external or internal data stores used to check existing user records?
